sentences.text: Marplesornis novaezealandiae, also known as Harris's penguin, is an extinct species from New Zealand belonging to the penguin family Spheniscidae.
This animal was a relatively large penguin, approximately the size of a king penguin.
George Gaylord Simpson later reclassified the species into the new monotypic genus Marplesornis to honor Brian Marples.
The genus lived between 2.4 and 1.63 million years ago during the Gelasian to Calabrian stages.
